test_cases.prompt: Review this PR for code quality issues.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes code-review skill to run two-axis review (Standards + Spec) with parallel sub-agents.
test_cases.notes: PR review request is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Check my branch against main before merging.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes code-review skill to compare branch diff against main using three-dot merge-base.
test_cases.notes: Branch review is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Verify this code implements the issue requirements.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes code-review skill with focus on Spec axis to trace diff against originating issue.
test_cases.notes: Spec traceability audit is a valid trigger.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes implement skill instead. Implement builds code; code-review evaluates existing diffs.
test_cases.notes: implement is the sibling skill for building code.

test_cases.prompt: This test is failing. Help me debug it.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes diagnosing-bugs skill instead. Diagnosing-bugs finds root cause; code-review assumes code exists.
test_cases.notes: diagnosing-bugs is the sibling skill for debugging.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes codebase-design skill instead. Codebase-design shapes future modules; code-review evaluates existing diffs.
test_cases.notes: codebase-design is the sibling skill for module design.

test_cases.prompt: Review this PR, but also check if it matches the original issue requirements.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes code-review skill with both Standards and Spec axes. Edge case: user wants both axes simultaneously, which is the default behavior but tests whether Spec axis is applied.
test_cases.notes: Dual-axis review is the standard behavior; tests that Spec axis is not skipped.
